summary: Catherine Stefani voted against the SF Board's January 2024 Gaza ceasefire resolution, insisting Hamas surrender, removal, and hostage return were prerequisites, and in committee highlighted the sexual violence Israeli women suffered on October 7. JCRC, ADL, and AJC named her among the three opponents, framing the stance as protecting Jewish community safety. She later voted Aye on AB 715, creating an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight.
